incident_updates.body:
We will perform scheduled maintenance on the Shared Pooler (Supavisor) in the ap-south-1 region on Thursday, December 10, from 11:00 to 13:00 UTC.

During the window, existing client connections may be dropped, and you may briefly see connection errors while traffic switches to the new version. Applications that reconnect and retry automatically will recover without action.

Direct database connections and the Dedicated Pooler are not affected
